description: This file defines a shared utility enum 'ShareToAgentSettings' for managing user default settings related to sharing instructions in an app. It includes methods to load and save default instructions, with fallback handling.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves the default instruction string from user defaults, falling back to a default message if none is set.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Saves a provided instruction string into user defaults, trimming whitespace and handling empty strings by removing the key.
